newsitem.title: GERMANY: FORWARDER SKS RE-NAMES AS SUEDKRAFT LOGISTIK INT'L.
newsitem.headline: FORWARDER SKS RE-NAMES AS SUEDKRAFT LOGISTIK INT'L.

text.p: German international freight forwarder SKS Logistics International GmbH said it has changed its name to Suedkraft Logistik International GmbH.
Alfred Lowski, the company's managing director, said the new name showed more strongly that the forwarder was part of the Munich-based Suedkraft transport group.

The subsidiary was formed in 1996 as an air and sea freight forwarder specialising in south-east Asia and the U.S. and now has shareholdings in companies in Antwerp, Bremen and Singapore, a company statement said.
